note: Set B is better because it accurately captures document metadata (revisions, client, project name) and transcribes dimension values faithfully (e.g., 8' - 4"), whereas Set A truncates values (8 ft vs 8' - 4") and misidentifies dimensions (DW width vs height). Set B has fewer value mismatches, though it incorrectly labels DW height as width. Set A also has binding errors (SK as component of MWK04).
